word_order: SVO | Most sample sentences place the subject before the verb and the object after the verb (e.g. “皮特曼认为天气情况要到下周才能改善”).
punctuation_present: always — as observed in the sample
notes_for_prompt_writer: Do not rely on spaces to find words; use punctuation and conjunctions as primary segmentation cues. Treat sentence-final punctuation (。 and closing quotes/parentheses) as hard segment boundaries. Avoid splitting inside pre-nominal modifier strings (relative clauses and long noun modifiers precede the noun) and wait after prepositions/conjunctions (e.g. 在/对于/如果/虽然/和) because the dependent phrase is likely to continue.
